speed.title: Unmatched speed
speed.text: The first batch of candidates will be selected within 3 to 5 days, not weeks, with a clear hiring process from the outset.

coverage.title: Full coverage of the Middle East and North Africa region
coverage.text: Candidates from Egypt, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, and other countries, for work remotely or from the office.

culture.title: Cultural suitability
culture.text: We assess personal skills and compatibility with your company culture, not just the technical tools used.

noFees.title: No upfront fees
noFees.text: The service is free until actual employment is completed, with no setup fees or prior commitment.

manager.title: Dedicated Account Manager
manager.text: One person will follow up with you from beginning to end and understand your company's needs, instead of dealing with a different employee each time.

evaluation.title: Real technical evaluation
evaluation.text: It is not just a process of sorting through resumes; technical experts conduct a specialized technical interview with a full report on each candidate.

fiveStages.heading: Six stages guarantee you the right candidate from the first time
fiveStages.subheading: A tried and tested hiring process, refined over hundreds of successful placements across the region.

discovery.title: Understanding employment needs
discovery.text: We begin by thoroughly understanding the job requirements: technical skills, experience level, and work culture. This step takes only 15 minutes.

sourcing.title: Attracting candidates from our network
sourcing.text: We sift through more than 8,850 technical professionals in our network, and select the one best suited to your specific requirements.

screening.title: Comparing profiles
screening.text: Each candidate is assessed according to job criteria — technical aspect, experience, and sector — before their file reaches you.

interviews.title: HR Interview and Technical Interview
interviews.text: Specialized interviews to assess professional background and compatibility with your company culture.

reporting.title: Full report and presentation
reporting.text: Detailed reports with evaluation results and clear recommendations; all that remains is for you to choose and approve.

guarantee.title: Replacement guarantee
guarantee.text: If the candidate is not suitable during the trial period, we will replace him immediately at no additional cost.

completeTeam.heading: A complete technical team in a week
completeTeam.text: GEOTech needed to quickly build a distributed technical team in Egypt and Saudi Arabia. Talento delivered the first batch of qualified candidates within 5 days, along with complete technical reports for each candidate.

duration.q: How long does the hiring process take?
duration.a: Most roles get a first batch of qualified candidates within 3–5 business days from kickoff, with a full hire typically closed within one to two weeks depending on interview scheduling.

fees.a: No. There are no subscription, monthly, or setup fees — you only pay once a candidate is actually hired.

plan.q: How long does it take to prepare a hiring plan?
plan.a: We put together a customized hiring plan within 15 minutes of your initial consultation call, based on the role, seniority, and budget you share with us.

guarantee.q: Is there a guarantee if the candidate isn't the right fit?
guarantee.a: Yes — every placement comes with a replacement guarantee. If a hire doesn't work out within the guarantee period, we source a replacement at no additional cost.

roles.q: Which technical roles do you recruit for?
roles.a: Frontend, backend, full-stack, mobile, DevOps/cloud, data engineering, UI/UX design, and QA — across seniority levels, for remote or on-site roles throughout the MENA region.

pricing.heading: You only pay when you hire
pricing.subheading: No retainers, no setup fees, no surprises. One transparent price, paid only once your new hire starts.
pricing.subtext: No subscriptions, monthly fees, or setup fees.
